# ============================================================================
# GBOGEB/CODEX — Asset Ingestion Pipeline
# Validates, cleans, and tracks visual assets on push/PR
# ============================================================================

name: Asset Ingestion

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'assets/canonical/**'
      - 'config/visual_data.yaml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'assets/canonical/**'
      - 'config/visual_data.yaml'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  validate-assets:
    name: Validate Visual Assets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install pyyaml

      - name: Validate all canonical assets
        run: |
          echo "═══ GBOGEB/CODEX — Asset Validation ═══"
          python src/asset_validator.py --input-dir assets/canonical/

      - name: Verify manifest integrity
        run: |
          python src/lineage_tracker.py --validate --manifest lineage_manifest.json || true

      - name: Check for untracked .mock files
        run: |
          MOCK_COUNT=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A -- '*.mock' | wc -l)
          if [ "$MOCK_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "⚠ WARNING: $MOCK_COUNT new .mock sidecar files detected"
            git diff --name-only --diff-filter=A -- '*.mock'
          fi

  clean-svgs:
    name: Clean & Optimize SVGs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate-assets
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install pyyaml

      - name: Clean SVGs → compiled/
        run: |
          echo "═══ GBOGEB/CODEX — SVG Cleaning ═══"
          python src/svg_cleaner.py --input-dir assets/canonical/ --output-dir assets/compiled/ --prefix gbc

      - name: Upload compiled assets
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: compiled-svgs
          path: assets/compiled/
          retention-days: 30

  update-lineage:
    name: Update Lineage Manifest
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: clean-svgs
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install pyyaml

      - name: Track all canonical assets
        run: |
          echo "═══ GBOGEB/CODEX — Lineage Update ═══"
          for svg in assets/canonical/*.svg; do
            if [ -f "$svg" ]; then
              python src/lineage_tracker.py --add "$svg" --category svg_diagram --manifest lineage_manifest.json
            fi
          done

      - name: Show lineage status
        run: python src/lineage_tracker.py --status --manifest lineage_manifest.json

      - name: Upload manifest
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lineage-manifest
          path: lineage_manifest.json
          retention-days: 90
